summary: B9: Board.Reports: burndown, velocity, cumulative flow, dashboards
description:
Landed in:
- DevHub-Plugins `28b782d`: B9: Board.Reports (requires Board) — report calculations in Reports.Core from the board and its change log (IssueTimeline: any field at any moment; sprint burndown with the ideal line and burnup with scope changes, sprint report: completed / not completed / added / removed, velocity and its average, cumulative flow, cycle times and the control chart, epic progress, issues counted by a field; 7 tests) and a Reports page on every board (report list, sprint picker, Sdk line / bar / pie charts, a dashboard of gadgets you add and remove: assigned to me, open issues by a field, a saved filter's results). Checked in a running DevHub
